messages:
Casey M: Drafting a tiny customer-facing playbook 'Surge Priming Handbook' for accounts that hit onboarding stalls. Need a 2-paragraph customer note + a 1-line AM pasteable and a short internal checklist (caching, batching, streaming, renewal trigger).
Lee S: Keep customer text friendly: what we did, why it helps, and how to tell us if it doesnt. AM snippet should be a single sentence.
Toni R: Internal checklist proposal:
- Warmup: send 3 quick synthetic prompts (0.5-2s jitter) to seed KV and attention caches.
- Edge cache: enable route+tenant keys, TTL 20m by default, reduce token spend on identical starter prompts.
- Batching: conservative defaults max_batch=12, max_wait_ms=40; lower batch if queue drops >5%.
- Streaming UX: immediate small ack chunk (100ms) then stream remainder; reconnect: linear 2s x3 then exponential up to 45s.
Casey M: Renewal trigger we can share with AMs: flag renewal_risk if ANY of these after 7 days: onboarding_completion < 60%, avg_first_week_latency > 1.5s, or >2 user-facing timeouts in 72h. Include exact thresholds so automation is possible.
Lee S: Pasteable AM line for support threads:
"Hi <Name>, we enabled a short warmup and temporary caching to smooth first responses—reply here if you still see lag and well schedule a 15-min tune-up."
Toni R: Telemetry tags: cs.surge_priming=true, cs.phase=seed|steady, cs.fallback_used=true. Dashboards: priming_hit_rate, kv_miss_rate, first_token_latency. Alert if kv_miss_rate > 12% for 10m.
cs-bot: Created stub at https://redwood.internal/cs/surge-priming-handbook (edit to finalize).
Casey M: Action items: Lee = finalize customer two-paragraph note + pasteable line; Toni = add dashboard tiles and alert; I'll pilot on one account and report p50/p95/p99 by EOD Fri. Thanks!
